normalization: NFKC + casefold + whitespace collapse; punctuation preserved
near_duplicate_limit: Train-fit word TF-IDF cosine >=0.95 flags review candidates, not proven leakage; misses semantic paraphrases.
data_policy: No source rows changed; sensitivity masks exclude only evaluation overlap with earlier official splits.
bias_limitations: Balanced intent counts do not demonstrate demographic fairness.
English crowdsourced assistant requests do not validate industrial or multilingual deployment.
No demographic annotations: protected-group fairness is not measured.
OOS label merges heterogeneous unsupported requests and is not a well-sampled 151st intent.
Simple email regex is not a complete privacy audit.
